verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party bulk export feature, such as a CSV or full-account export. What it does show is a REST API for querying people with selectable fields, custom fields and trash inclusion. That API is a developer building block a user could script into an export, not a documented export-and-leave capability. 'Cancel any time' covers contract terms, not data portability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Follow Up Boss provides a simple [REST API](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Representational_state_transfer) that allows developers to integrate their applications quickly.
